messages:
mira: Heads-up — CloudWave and I finished the draft onboarding checklist for APAC South‑West (ap-southwest-1). We need marketplace quota approval + legal blurb for the joint listing. Target launch window: Apr 7–9. Who can own the quota request and the listing copy?

alex: I can own the quota request. Need exact SKUs and expected QPS/token throughput. Drop the numbers and I’ll file.

mira: Draft numbers below. Steady-state capacity: 100 vGPU-equivalent slots, burst up to 300 for the first 30 days while we ramp. Primary SKUs: g5.48xlarge and g5.12xlarge. Token throughput estimate: ~2B tokens/week at steady. Payload I’m about to send to partner support: 

```
{ "region": "ap-southwest-1", "capacity_commitment": { "steady": 100, "burst": 300 }, "skus": ["g5.48xlarge","g5.12xlarge"], "est_tokens_per_week": 2000000000 }
```

priya: Sales-eng note — marketplace listing must expose both Dedicated (reserved) and Hosted SKU options. Also need pricing tiers (starter, standard, enterprise) mapped to quota ranges. I’ll draft pricing passthrough and examples for the listing.

tom: From infra side: we need subnet peering, NLB certs, and a CIDR whitelist for partner build agents. Please include a VPC endpoint plan — we need 72h lead time for cert provisioning and IP allowlist changes.

mira: @jen — can you review the proposed “data handling” blurb for the listing and the partner’s joint announcement? CloudWave wants a copy they can use.

jen: I’ll review this morning. Quick question: do we have a firm data residency statement for ap-southwest yet? If not, recommend we say: "Data processed in-region where supported" and link to our compliance page. I’ll also check any marketplace-required clauses.

marketplace-bot: marketplace quota request #3421 created (owner: alex). Vendor ETA: 3–5 business days. See https://marketplace.internal/requests/3421

alex: Filed request with SKU list, capacity numbers, and token throughput. I attached the partner signed LOI and our expected traffic matrix. I’ll nudge the vendor via the portal if no response by EOD.

mira: Action items recap: alex — own quota request & follow up with vendor; jen — draft listing/data blurb + legal ok; tom — networking & certs; priya — pricing mapping + marketplace UI mappings; I’ll coordinate CloudWave sync. Scheduling: propose 30m call with CloudWave tomorrow 09:30 PDT to walk the checklist. Any conflicts?

priya: Works for me :thumbsup:

tom: Works

jen: OK

mira: Great — I’ll send the invite and include marketplace request link and the draft LOI. If we get a greenlight before EOD Friday we can make the Apr 7 window. :rocket:

mira: (PS — Alex, after you get vendor ticket number, drop it here and I’ll add to the exec tracker)
